2.0.0: Resolved the issues caused by the new LinkedIn API changes.
2.1.0: Updated to new LinkedIn API version and quota.
2.2.0: Updated to new LinkedIn API version.
2.3.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the LinkedIn API.
2.4.0: New CreateCompanyPost component publishes posts on behalf of a LinkedIn company page. It requires the w_organization_social and rw_organization_admin permissions (LinkedIn Community Management API).
Updated CreatePost and MakeApiCall to LinkedIn API version 202608 (version 202506 was sunset on June 15, 2026).
CreatePost: validates the required text and the URL and title of a shared link before calling LinkedIn.
